events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence — GOMA
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: An expansive, multi-sensory exhibition by Icelandic-Danish artist Olafur Eliasson, engaging visitors with perception-focused installations developed over three decades. This Brisbane-exclusive show spans GOMA's ground floor galleries.

events.title: GOMA Friday Night — Last session during Olafur Eliasson: Presence
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: Experience GOMA's transformation into an after-dark cultural destination with art, music, performances, and cocktails, set against Olafur Eliasson's exhibition. This is the final Friday night event for the 'Presence' exhibition.

events.title: Open Season — Thomas Dixon Centre
events.description: An exhibition showcasing contemporary visual works as part of the Thomas Dixon Centre's broader 'Open Season' arts program. Immerse yourself in a variety of theatre, music, and art performances.

events.title: Spanish & Latin American Film Festival
events.location: Palace Barracks & Palace James St Cinemas
events.description: A curated program showcasing diverse cinema from Spain and Latin America, offering cultural insights and artistic storytelling. Screenings are held at multiple Palace Cinemas locations.

events.title: The Red Dress — Museum of Brisbane
events.location: Museum of Brisbane, City Hall, Brisbane CBD
events.description: An extraordinary textile art project featuring an intricate embroidery created by 24 members of Brisbane's Allthreads community, beautifully capturing Australia's unique landscape. This is its first showing in Australia.

events.title: Mental As Anything — 50th Anniversary Tour
events.description: A rare opportunity to see beloved Australian rock/pop icons Mental As Anything celebrate their 50th anniversary in an intimate theatre setting. Expect classic hits and a lively atmosphere.

events.title: An Evening of German Classics — Liederfest Prize Winners Concert 2026
events.description: A classical vocal recital showcasing prize-winning singers performing exquisite German art songs. This concert offers an evening of high artistic value for classical music enthusiasts.

events.title: Beetlejuice The Musical
events.description: The eight-time Tony Award-nominated musical returns to Australia, led by Broadway star Andy Karl. It tells the ghoulishly fun story of Lydia Deetz and her obsession with the afterlife.

events.title: Rusalka — Opera Queensland
events.description: Opera Queensland presents a breathtaking production of Rusalka, a shimmering fairytale of love, sacrifice, and longing. This major opera opens as part of Brisbane's winter performing arts season.

events.title: Hamlet — Queensland Ballet
events.description: Queensland Ballet presents international choreographer Leo Mujić's gripping dance drama retelling of Shakespeare's tragedy. Witness a powerful performance exploring love, power, and corruption.

events.title: Sister Act the Musical — Savoyards Musical Theatre Brisbane
events.description: Savoyards Musical Theatre Brisbane proudly presents the Queensland Community Theatre premiere of Sister Act. Enjoy a vibrant, fun, and lively night out with this community-led musical production.

events.title: BIG IDEAS Book Club — Monthly Meetup
events.location: Venue TBC via Meetup (Brisbane CBD area)
events.description: A monthly meetup for discussing significant ideas from philosophy, psychology, economics, politics, sociology, and science. Topics range from 'free will' to key thinkers like Carl Jung, fostering intellectual engagement.

events.title: Brisbane Write Club — Writing Session
events.description: The Brisbane Write Club offers dedicated writing time and the chance to connect with other local writers of all levels. Each session provides 1 hour and 45 minutes of continuous writing.

events.title: Brisbane Active Socials — Hiking / Camping
events.description: An early-morning outdoor adventure with a regular group for hiking, camping, and more. Ideal for meeting energetic, nature-loving locals and exploring Brisbane's surrounds.

events.title: Westend Fresh Connections — Friday Social Meetup
events.location: West End (check Meetup for exact venue)
events.description: A recurring community social in the vibrant West End neighbourhood, offering a relaxed atmosphere for interesting locals to connect. Enjoy casual conversation and good company.

events.title: Brisbane Social Geeks — Social Meetup
events.description: A recurring group for curious, tech-minded, and pop-culture-loving locals to connect in a laid-back social setting. Share interests and meet like-minded people.

events.title: Easy Social Dancing — Mix n Mingle (Free 1st Class)
events.description: A welcoming, low-pressure social dance event running every Monday. The first class is free, making it perfect for meeting new people and trying out social dancing.

events.title: Latin Social Dancing — Brisbane Social Club
events.description: A vibrant, community-led Latin dance social designed for friendship and adventure. Enjoy lively dancing and connect with a mixed, friendly crowd.

events.title: Climate Fresk Brisbane — Lunch & Learn
events.description: An interactive workshop designed to educate and raise awareness about climate change using a systems thinking approach. Participants collaboratively build a 'fresk' to understand climate science and solutions.
